verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents ingesting alerts from external monitoring systems along with relevant data, grouping them into cases, and marketing copy mentions ongoing monitoring. Nothing in the evidence shows a view of what changed for a monitored customer between alerts, such as a diff, a change history, or a comparison against a prior state. The audit trail covers work done inside Hummingbird, not changes to customer data, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.
